description: This file implements a set of reasoning functions for evaluating the faithfulness of responses, utilizing an adversarial debate pattern including claim extraction, prosecutor attack, defender support, and an impartial judge. It defines multiple asynchronous functions registered as reasoners within a router, focusing on the evaluation workflow for faithfulness verification.

methods.name: dict extract_claims( response: str, context: str, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Decomposes a response into atomic, verifiable claims using AI analysis.

methods.name: dict prosecute_claims( claims: List[Dict], context: str, response: str, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Acts as an adversarial prosecutor to find issues in claims relative to context.

methods.name: dict defend_claims( claims: List[Dict], context: str, response: str, attacks: List[Dict], model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Provides evidence-based defenses for claims against attacks.

methods.name: dict judge_faithfulness( claims: List[Dict], prosecution: Dict, defense: Dict, context: str, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Impartial judge weighing evidence to produce an overall faithfulness score and verdict.

methods.name: dict evaluate_faithfulness_full( response: str, context: str, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Orchestrates the full adversarial debate workflow for comprehensive faithfulness evaluation.

methods.name: dict evaluate_faithfulness_quick( response: str, context: str, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Performs a faster, single-shot faithfulness evaluation without detailed debate.
